verified_card_facts.breach: {1}{R}, each nonland card in graveyard has escape with its mana cost + exile three OTHER graveyard cards; end-step sacrifice
verified_card_facts.led: {0} artifact; activate only any time you could cast instant, discard your hand and sacrifice to add 3 of one chosen color; mana ability no stack; CANNOT use LED while in process of casting Breach from hand
verified_card_facts.brain_freeze: {1}{U} instant, target player mills 3; storm copies for EACH spell previously CAST this turn, copies are not cast and do not add new storm count

physical_preconditions.source: 99 actual card-name physical library, commander excluded, no invented own cards
physical_preconditions.setup: Source-pay Breach from hand using existing named Mountain for red and Island for one generic in same main phase; count that cast toward storm. Breach remains on battlefield. LED and Brain Freeze are physically located in graveyard, with 12 distinct additional actual nonland spells in graveyard; two actual cards in hand for LED to discard. Conditional prepared state is NOT representative of random draw access.
physical_preconditions.payment: Each escaped LED costs {0} + 3 OTHER cards exiled; resolving LED is sacrificed as no-stack mana ability to add {U}{U}{U} and discard hand; escaped Brain Freeze costs {1}{U} (two U from pool) + 3 OTHER cards exiled, leaving one additional U per cycle
physical_preconditions.storm: Breach cast first, then LED, then Brain Freeze; first Brain Freeze has two previous actual casts (Breach and LED), hence 2 storm copies + original. Next LED and Brain Freeze makes 4 previous casts, hence 4 copies + original. Targets may be divided between self and opponent; copies are NOT new casts.
physical_preconditions.zones: Source 99-card multiset conserved across library/hand/field/graveyard/stack/exile; activated LED and nonpermanent Brain Freeze return to graveyard, exiled escape fodder stays exiled, tokens/copies are virtual not 99 cards.

registered_cases.expected: Paid Breach plus two genuinely escaped LED/Brain Freeze iterations: 5 casts, storm 2 then 4 copies, self-mill physical 6 cards, opponent requested mill 18, 12 exact physical escape-fodder cards exiled, mana pool net +2 U and actual 99 names conserved; conditional not unbounded.

After four escape casts exactly 12 OTHER physical cards exiled, never the escaped card itself, LED/Brain Freeze remain graveyard after their respective resolution, valid self-milled cards may become later fodder.
LED cannot legally escape with fewer than three OTHER graveyard cards even when its mana cost is 0; do not conjure cards or implicitly pay later.
LED activation discards every physically sourced hand card, creates UUU as mana ability (no stack), and cannot be used retroactively to pay the already performed Breach-from-hand casting cost.
If LED adds RRR and no separate U is available, Brain Freeze escape fails its {1}{U} mana portion despite adequate graveyard fodder.
With Rule of Law, Breach cast from hand is spell one; no further escaped LED/Brain Freeze spell cast allowed this turn.
Opponent-controlled Drannith Magistrate prevents casting escape spells from graveyard, even with Breach present and mana/fodder.

LED activation grants UUU immediately (no stack), but opponent removing Breach before next spell cast revokes escape permission; mana remains floating until used/phase ends. No automatic response to LED mana ability itself.

Countering original escaped Brain Freeze after storm trigger has resolved does not counter already-created spell copies; their separately targeted mill still resolves, original remains in graveyard, copied spells are not cast.

truth_limits: A fixed physical source/hand/graveyard is an attainable conditional setup, not a measured opening frequency.
Two cycles prove bounded mana/escape/storm mechanics, NOT an infinite loop or mill-the-table win.
Opponent library names and counters not simulated; mill amounts are REQUESTED, actual cards milled capped by opponent library.
Do not claim unrestricted escape without source-graveyard fodder or legal priority.
M6.6 inventory can have zero identified P0 remaining after 9 pass, but formal M6 completion and I/J require a separate comprehensive evidence and certification review.
